'''Knellis''' was an industrial [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. Located east of [[Tekar]], it was home to a [[Friends of Paran base|base]] operated by the [[Friends of Paran]] resistance group.
